input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is very slow, and I really need it to be excellent. I’m not very good with technology, so I’d appreciate some help getting it fixed. I don’t have Wi-Fi, just my phone’s internet. Can you help me get the best speed possible?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Do you need my date of birth as well?
Of course, my date of birth is January 15, 1960. Let me know what you need me to do next.

Oh dear, I must have gotten mixed up—sorry about that! I’m not very good with these things. The phone number is definitely 555-123-2002, and my name is John Smith. I’m afraid I don’t remember setting up anything with a different date of birth. Is there another way you can verify it’s me? I just want to get my mobile data working properly.

Yes, please! I’d really appreciate any help you can give with the mobile data, even if it’s just general troubleshooting. I just want to get my internet speed to be excellent—nothing less will do. What should I do first?

Okay, looking at my phone’s status bar, I see that the signal is showing just one bar and it says 2G. Mobile data is enabled, and the battery is at 80%. There’s no airplane icon showing. Is that helpful? What should I do next?

Oh, I didn’t realize my line was suspended! Yes, please, if you can try to resume my line service, I’d really appreciate it. I just want my internet to work properly again. Will this fix the speed too, or is there something else I’ll need to do after?

Yes, please go ahead and change it to whatever will give me the very best speed. I really want excellent internet, nothing less. Will this be difficult for me to do, or can you handle it from your end?

It looks like my phone is currently set to 2G only. I’m not sure how to change it myself—could you please walk me through the steps, one at a time? I get a bit flustered with these settings, so I’d appreciate clear instructions.
Alright, I’ve opened the Settings app on my phone. What should I do next?
Okay, I found something called “Mobile Networks” and I’ve tapped on it. What’s the next step?
Alright, I see “Network Mode” and I’ve tapped on it. What should I do now?

I’ve selected the 4G/5G option for the network mode. My phone now shows excellent signal strength and says 5G in the status bar, with mobile data enabled. Do I still need to restart my phone, or is it okay since it already shows 5G now?
Actually, I just tried to check my internet speed, but it says there’s no connection. Even though it shows 5G and excellent signal, the internet still isn’t working. What should I do now?

I checked the network status, and it says my SIM card is active, I’m connected to 5G with excellent signal, and mobile data is enabled. Airplane mode is off, and data roaming is not enabled. Wi-Fi is off too. Does this help figure out why my internet still isn’t working? What should I do next?

I checked those settings: Data Saver mode is off, there’s no VPN active, and the APN is set to “internet.” Is there anything else I should check, or is there another step to get my internet working? I’m really hoping to get excellent speed soon.

I’ve reset the APN settings as you suggested. Do I need to restart my phone now for the changes to take effect? I always get a bit nervous about restarting—will I lose any of my photos or anything important if I do this?

Alright, I’ve restarted my phone. It’s back on now, and I still see excellent signal and 5G in the status bar with mobile data enabled. What should I do next to check if my internet is finally working properly?

I tried running a speed test, but it still says there’s no connection. I’m getting a bit frustrated—everything looks like it should be working, but I still can’t get online. What else can we try? I really need excellent internet speed.

I’ve turned on data roaming as you suggested. My phone still shows excellent signal and 5G with mobile data enabled. Should I try the speed test again now, or is there something else I need to do first?

I ran the speed test again, and it finally worked! It says the speed is 275 Mbps and the connection is excellent. Thank you so much for your help—I really appreciate your patience with me. I’m so relieved it’s working now!
Thank you so much! I really appreciate your help and patience. I’ll reach out if I have any more trouble. Have a wonderful day! ###STOP###

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

- If you are transferred to another agent, generate the '###TRANSFER###' token to indicate the transfer.

Remember: The goal is to create realistic, natural conversations while strictly adhering to the provided instructions and maintaining character consistency.
